about: [C12] II The Fight's good play by the pad alone (the fake pad; the keyboard and the mouse never used): X on BEGIN at the fight, then tools/lib/fight_bot.mjs 'good' with its hands on the pad (input: pad - the left stick's flick toward the light for the dodge, L2 the left fist and R2 the right, X held to block, square to take what is slid over): wins, twice in a row; the dodge card and the lesson's cards drawn in the pad's glyphs; the rumble on the blows. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/pad_fight_good.json
